summary: Give the genie dev shell its own python3 so CI script checks do not depend on a host-provided Python, including on NixOS.

replay.detail: No replay or persistent data behavior changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination change.

compatibility.detail: No client, protocol or harness contract change. The genie dev shell now supplies the same pkgs.python3 used by checks.genie-freshness.

downtime.detail: No daemon restart or service interruption.

manual.detail: No manual steps; nix develop .#genie supplies Python automatically.

recovery.detail: Revert the shell package addition to restore the previous development environment; no stored state changes.
